prompt: A windswept grassy river bluff high above a wide brown river valley: tall prairie grass and wildflowers bent hard by the wind, a lone twisted cottonwood leaning with the gusts, streaks of wind and drifting seed fluff in the air, torn white clouds racing across a bright blue sky, kites of swallows far off. Wide open flat ground across the whole lower half of the scene for two creatures to stand on, horizon in the upper third. No creatures, no people, no text.
